title: Ephemeral identity lifecycle: missing audit events and RBAC rebind during KMS rewrap
creator: Asha Patel
description: Multiple customers running Private control planes reported intermittent authorization failures and missing audit events immediately following a scheduled KMS envelope rotation. Symptoms include: transient 403s on previously-allowed calls, RBAC role bindings appearing stale in console, and gaps in audit logs for key user activity windows. Initial triage shows correlation with the async key rewrap job and ephemeral identity eviction flow; we believe a race between claim rewrap and the RBAC cache eviction produced orphaned identities and suppressed audit writes.
reproduction_steps: 1) On a private cluster, trigger a KMS envelope rotation while sustained SSO traffic is flowing (simulate customer login bursts).
2) Run the existing async rewrap worker with artificially delayed KMS unwrap to amplify timing window.
3) Observe that some ephemeral identity claims are evicted by the TTL checker while the rewrap completes, resulting in missing entitlement reconciliation and no audit event for the eviction window.
4) Confirm that RBAC cache entries remain pointing at the old tenant mapping for ~30s and subsequent calls are rejected until a manual cache refresh or re-login.
mitigation: Deploy immediate hotfix to serialize rewrap and eviction for ephemeral identity objects (patch v0).
Add temporary knob to increase claim TTL during rotation windows as a stopgap for affected customers.
Manual customer remediation playbook: run forced cache refresh, rewrap verification script, and backfill audit events from agent traces where available.
proposed_fix: Primary: change rewrap worker to adopt two-phase handoff: mark objects as 'rewrap-in-progress' -> pause eviction -> complete unwrap/rewrap -> mark complete, then allow eviction. This removes the race window.
Secondary: add idempotent audit write with dedupe keys so transient errors during rotation are retried and visible in logs.
Tertiary: strengthen KMS client error classification and exponential backoff for transient unwrap timeouts to avoid silent suppression.
verification_plan: Unit tests for rewrap state machine covering concurrent eviction scenarios.
Integration test in staging private cluster: orchestrate rotation under load and verify no 403s, RBAC cache consistency, and audit continuity for 60 minutes post-rotation.
Canary deploy to 2 low-risk customers with opt-in and monitoring hooks for error rate and audit gap metrics.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge hotfix branch and create patch release private-2026.03.2-hotfix-1.
2) Canary deploy to internal staging cluster + two consenting customers (scheduled maintenance window).
3) Monitor SLOs and audit completeness metrics for 24h; if green, roll forward to remaining Private clusters in waves every 2 hours.
4) For Dedicated/Hosted customers, schedule patch in next minor release (no immediate customer impact observed there).
communication: Support note drafted and posted to customer incidents channel with mitigation steps and expected timeline.
Outreach: PM to coordinate targeted emails to affected tenants with remediation steps and offer assistance for audit backfill.
Status page: temporary note under Private > Security indicating ongoing patch rollout and ETA for full remediation.
